boundary: Synthetic ObjectStroke ARM64 Unicorn and host Mesa RGBA8; SVG resvg and PDF MuPDF, no device or saved-note parity. Native RGB treated as premultiplied. Metrics: support native/export/intersection/union and RGB L1 over union, threshold 2 from paper 252.

retained_native_frames.description: Lossless native pixels in original retained byte order, without reorientation. Palette entries are [red, green, blue, alpha]; runs are [pixel_count, palette_index]. Keys and source_sha256 frame entries name retired zlib storage; historical_zlib_sha256 preserves that compressed identity. rgba_sha256 identifies reconstructed native bytes. Acquisition inputs, scripts and historical reader metrics remain unchanged.
